email.body1:
Jacob, saw PerformYard shipped Meetings and a survey tool, broadening the platform fast.

When the product surface grows, the buying signals multiply faster than ops can route them, so in-market accounts sit untouched while the data settles. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signals into booked meetings: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for PerformYard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jacob, quick follow-up for PerformYard.

The usual ops bottleneck is latency: a signal fires, but it takes days to enrich, route, and act, so the account goes cold. Tightening that loop is where measurable lift lives, and our best practices alone tend to raise response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I would make first.
email.body3:
Jacob, last bit of proof for PerformYard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PerformYard's reply rate likely compares to other HR-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Jacob, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action is not a priority while you roll out the new products, no problem at all. Timing matters around launches, and I know it keeps a RevOps team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to PerformYard either way.
